choices.monthly_return: Last non-missing close of the month over the last non-missing close of the immediately preceding calendar month, minus one. A month with no close breaks the chain: neither it nor the month after it has a return.
choices.complete_month: Applied to the NDX file only, as the PREREG states it under the NDX bullet. A month is complete if any row date in the file falls in a later month, or the last row date in the file (whether or not its value is blank) is the final Monday-to-Friday day of that month. The French file is not tested for completeness; months with no French RF row are dropped, as the binding details say.
choices.monthly_rf: Product of (1 + RF_d / 100) over the French rows dated in the month, minus one. A month with no French row is dropped from every sample.
choices.sample_start: Full sample and replication begin at the first month for which a return exists, which is the second calendar month in the NDX file; this is read as 'the first full month after the NDX start'. The replication runs from that month to 2002-12 inclusive; OOS runs from 2003-01 to the last complete month, both after dropping months without RF.
choices.regression: e_m = a + c W_m + u_m by OLS; Newey-West covariance with Bartlett weights 1 - l / (L + 1), L = 3, no small-sample correction (no n / (n - k) factor). t = c / sqrt(V[c, c]). The regression is not scored (null) with fewer than three months or with no variation in W.
choices.verdict: INSUFFICIENT if the OOS month count is below 120; otherwise PASS if c > 0 and t >= 2.0, FAIL otherwise. criteria.primary carries the same three-way label.
choices.winter_beats_summer: A winter is Nov(Y) to Apr(Y+1) and its following summer is May(Y+1) to Oct(Y+1). Only pairs with all twelve months inside the OOS sample are counted, so the winter straddling the 2003-01 OOS start is excluded. Cumulative return of a season is the compounded NDX total return (not the excess return) over its six months. Share = pairs where winter > summer, over pairs counted; null if no pair.
choices.strategy_stats: Monthly total return: NDX return in winter months, compounded monthly RF in summer months (held: NDX return every month). Annual return = (product of (1 + s_m)) ^ (12 / n) - 1. Volatility = sample standard deviation (n - 1) of s_m times sqrt(12). Sharpe = sqrt(12) times mean(s_m - rf_m) over sample standard deviation (n - 1) of (s_m - rf_m). Max drawdown = minimum over months of wealth / running peak - 1, with the starting wealth of 1 included in the peak; reported as a non-positive fraction.
choices.missing_values: In ndx.csv a value that is blank, '.', 'NA', 'NaN' or otherwise unparseable is a missing close for that date; the date still counts for the complete-month rule. In ff5_daily.csv a row whose first cell is not a date (YYYYMMDD or YYYY-MM-DD) is skipped, which covers French's preamble and footer lines; a row whose RF cell is not a number is skipped and counted.
